name: understand-this-video
description: Let your AI watch and hear a video: key frames, transcript and contact sheet, processed locally.
long_description: Put a video in the Understand This Video folder on your Desktop (the installer creates it) and ask your AI to understand it by name, or just say 'my latest video'. It gets timestamped key frames, a transcript (local Whisper when installed) and a contact-sheet image. This plugin does not download videos from the internet. Requires ffmpeg and a $49 lifetime license.

tools.name: understand_this_video
tools.description: Watch and hear a local video file: key frames, transcript, contact sheet.
